_note: 3 Series MDO procedure: expanded uncertainties for the stimulus and reference instruments that are NOT in the A2LA scope (same mechanism as mdo4000c_reference_cmc.json). Fill in the values from your own scope of accreditation or the instrument specifications. uncertainty = rel x |reading| + abs. A blank (null) entry is reported as N/A. Points with no input signal are always N/A. ABSAMP uses the Fluke 96270A sheet when it covers the sweep; DVMFREQ / AFGFREQ never print below the lab Frequency - Measure CMC. REFFREQ is in divisions on this procedure.
